runtime_policy.candidate_order: current variables in canonical increasing order
runtime_policy.candidate_producer: frozen R47M exact-DP plus full existing-stack closure
runtime_policy.eligible: verified semantic terminal OR strict variable decrease with no fresh variables
runtime_policy.nonterminal_width_safe: max clause width of normalized successor <=4
runtime_policy.restart: persist selected nonterminal width-safe normalized successor and rescan
runtime_policy.failure: If no terminal and no eligible nonterminal successor has width<=4, independently replay every produced candidate and seal the state as an explicit counterexample to universal W=4 coverage.

proof_carrying_integrity: reconstruct exact sealed reachable root hash/CLV
every selected candidate passes full R47M independent replay
every selected nonterminal successor strictly decreases variables and introduces no fresh variables
every selected nonterminal successor has max width <=4
any counterexample claim independently replays every produced candidate
any SAT terminal reconstructs the model through the entire selected projection chain and verifies the sealed root
